video_summary.overall_goal: Navigate WiFiAnalyzer app through multiple views: Access Points list, Channel Rating, Channel Graph, Time Graph
video_summary.description: User opens WiFiAnalyzer app from Google Play Store page, taps Open button, then navigates through app's four main tabs showing WiFi analysis data

steps.screen_name: Google Play Store - WiFiAnalyzer App Page
steps.what_screen_is_visible: WiFiAnalyzer app listing on Google Play Store with green WiFi icon, app name, 'Updated 2 months ago', Uninstall and Open buttons

steps.screen_name: Google Play Store - WiFiAnalyzer App Page
steps.what_screen_is_visible: Same app listing page, cyan Open button highlighted

App opens showing Access Points list with WiFi networks, signal strengths (green checkmarks for good signal), MAC addresses, frequencies, security info. Header shows 'Access Points' with filter and pause icons. Red warning: 'Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled'
steps.system_response: Access Points tab loaded with live network data
steps.intent_task: View WiFi networks and signal info

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Access Points list visible, shows multiple networks with varying signal strengths (yellow, green indicators)
steps.system_response: List scrolled to show more networks

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Channel Rating tab now active at bottom. Shows 'Best Channels: 20 MHz 9,10,11' and table with Channel Rating (yellow/green stars), Channel Number, Access Point Count. Channels 1-8 have yellow stars (7-8 stars), channels 9-11 have green stars (lower priority/worse rating)
steps.intent_task: View WiFi channel ratings and recommendations

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Channel Graph tab now active. Shows colorful stacked bar chart with WiFi channel numbers (1-13) on X-axis and signal strength (dBm) on Y-axis. Multiple colored bars represent different networks: blue, cyan, purple, magenta, yellow. Legend shows network names like 'ThodaSaSignal 6', 'TrapLordRicky 6', etc.
Channel Graph still displayed, with finger visible interacting with chart area (possible tap or drag gesture on graph)

Time Graph tab now active (4th tab at bottom). Shows line/area graph with 'Scan Count' on X-axis. Multiple colored overlapping areas representing different networks over time. Legend shows network names
Time Graph displayed, finger visible touching/interacting with graph area
Back to Channel Rating tab. Shows channel rating table with channels 1-11 visible with star ratings and counts. Finger visible interacting with list
Channel Rating tab remains active. App is idle, showing same data as step 10 (channels 1-11 with ratings)
steps.system_response: App displays static content, periodic WiFi scans in background

overall_flow: User views WiFiAnalyzer app store page
Taps Open button to launch app
App loads and shows Access Points tab with live WiFi network list
Scrolls down in Access Points list
Taps Channel Rating tab to view channel recommendations
Taps Channel Graph tab to see graphical channel visualization
Taps Time Graph tab to view signal strength over time
App idles, displaying Channel Rating data
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: User reviews WiFiAnalyzer app listing on Google Play Store
Step 2: User taps Open button to launch the app
Step 3: App launches showing Access Points tab with live WiFi network scan results
Step 4: User scrolls down in the Access Points list to see more networks
Step 5: User taps Channel Rating tab showing recommended WiFi channels (best: 20MHz 9,10,11)
Step 6: User taps Channel Graph tab showing stacked bar chart of channel usage
Step 7: User interacts with Channel Graph (tap or drag gesture)
Step 8: User taps Time Graph tab showing signal strength trends over scan count
Step 9: User interacts with Time Graph (tap or drag gesture)
Step 10: User taps back to Channel Rating tab
Step 11: App remains idle on Channel Rating tab for remaining duration (~11 seconds)
